svg.title: M1A2 SEP — source-aligned structural vector
svg.desc: Vectorized from supplied m1a2_sep.png, 1465x514. Guided pixel-gradient segmentation, binary background flood fill, connected components, boundary tracing and RDP 0.75-1.35 source pixels; long tube and plate joints fitted to extracted pixels. Seven individually image-fitted circular road wheels. No texture detail. No embedded raster.
